items.question: What mental state and spatial arrangement must participants maintain during the propitiation?
premises: Participants must remain composed as before.
Each participant must occupy their own respective direction.
The participants must be properly stationed in place.
items.inference: Proper ritual propitiation requires prior composure and correct directional placement.
items.plain_english: Composed as before, they should be properly stationed, each in their own direction.
